title: Define functional release gate and fixture strategy
purpose: Define the fixture-backed replay strategy that will prove functional capabilities without external dependencies.
scope: Design a functional replay suite that covers package, content, Firecracker fail-closed, diagnostics, support bundle, rollback, and audit export.
Define fixture directories and result JSON shape.
Define which checks are local-only baseline and which checks are optional QEMU/host integration.
Define how build-release provenance records capability matrix and replay hashes.
implementation_steps: Define replay fixture taxonomy and result schema.
Specify commands for local-only replay and optional QEMU replay.
Specify release provenance additions: matrix hash, replay hash, fixture inventory, gate versions.
Record evidence with all planned commands and blocker handling.
acceptance_criteria: The gate strategy can run without external LLM, network, Firecracker, or package manager.
QEMU path is parameterized and defaults to E:\qemu\qemu-system-x86_64.exe when used.
Release provenance records enough hashes for replay traceability.
Failures are categorized as remediation-required or rollout-blocked.
verification: Confirm planned commands include `cargo test --workspace` and a functional replay script placeholder.
failure_modes: Replay depends on live network by default.
QEMU path is hard-coded in a way that cannot be overridden.
